name: Nova Legends
tagline: A multiplayer top-down knight shooter on a game engine the team built from scratch.

awards: Druide – Best Use of Language (Presentation) // Druide – Meilleure utilisation de la langue (présentation)

problem: The team wanted to show that a custom engine can feel tighter than a generic one.
solution: Custom physics, animation and dual-mode camera services, real-time chat and a map generator, with multiplayer over sockets.
demo_moment: Team-described: two players duel in a generated arena.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Druide – Best Use of Language (Presentation) // Druide – Meilleure utilisation de la langue (présentation)” among 260 submissions.

lessons: A two-person team can win on presentation by explaining hard engineering simply.
